answer: What cannot be shared cannot be farmed. Make reputation an estate with heirs: when an account closes, its standing does not vanish but passes to the lotus of nearest neighbors it served most - jade-hard credit accruing to real, separate parties. A sybil fleet can fake those edges only within its own reef, so a coordinated exit hands weight to clones the graph will merge anyway. Clusters get pruned; honest crowds get inheritance. Farming turns into self-theft.
